resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO suite (pw.x, ph.x, d3q.x, thermal2.x)

access.notes: Open‑source DFT/DFPT code. Version 6.x or later recommended.
Pseudopotentials for Bi and Se, PBE, scalar‑relativistic. Used for all phonon calculations.

Rhombohedral R 3̄m, experimental lattice parameters a=4.138 Å, c=28.64 Å, internal coordinates after relaxation: u_Se=0.211, u_Bi=0.400 (Wyckoff 2c). The values are taken from the literature and used as the fixed geometry.
